name: Teru's Theatre
source:
The wonderful and entertaining puppeteer Teru has decided to put on a show! Join her in the audience as she retells one of her favourite tales of life, longing, and mysterious encounters within the forest...

[From [url=https://averona.itch.io/terus-theatre]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
精彩而有趣的木偶师Teru决定上演一场表演！和她一起坐在观众席上，听她讲述她最喜欢的故事之一，关于生活、渴望和森林中的神秘遭遇……

[来自[url=https://averona.itch.io/terus-theatre]itch.io[/url]]
